meta.title: Best-offer review times are shown only to the buyer and the vendors asked for a best offer, and only during the window
gaps: No setup recipe creates a closed pricing round with a best-offer review window for only one vendor and a separate cost-breakdown window.
No operation can configure or represent best-offer review windows or cost-breakdown windows.
read_round does not expose the best-offer review end time, review type, price-increase-allowed flag, or cost-breakdown start, end, and type fields.
The required during-window and after-window comparisons cannot be arranged or asserted with the available tokens and read-back fields.
